title: Questions and rhetoric
subtitle: Read a question’s expected force from its context.
overview: A Greek question may genuinely seek information, challenge an assumption, or press an argument rhetorically. The syntax marks a question; the context reveals its force.
Keep question words, negative particles, and the preceding argument visible before deciding whether English needs a rhetorical tone.
